svg.aria-label: Starlight Camera manual setup: phone only, no PC, no ADB, no root
svg.text: Starlight Camera vMax .51 · Redmi Note 10 Pro Max
Everything happens on the phone. No PC, no cable, no root.

g.text: Open the release page in your phone browser.
Tap each file — they save to Download.
Settings → Apps → find LMC / GCam / Starlight.
Uninstall it. Same package name, so it cannot
Allow installs from your file manager if asked.
No root, no ADB, no developer options.
Put the .so in LMC8.4/libs as well.
Launch Starlight Camera from the app drawer.
You should land on the viewfinder.
Double-tap the black area beside the shutter.
The app restarts itself, already tuned.
Pick the library for each lens
In Main, Tele, Wide and Front choose
Settings → Starlight Camera: Auto upscale ON.
Video upscale ON for 4K. Potato mode if slow.

svg.text: Off on all three is a true bypass.
uninstall the old LMC / GCam first
XML must be in /sdcard/LMC8.4/, then double-tap → IMPORT
turn Auto upscale ON in Settings
pick a media opener app in Settings
Unofficial mod built on Google Camera (GCam) and LMC 8.4 R17 · all processing is on-device · nothing is uploaded
